notes.title: Spring Sale 2024 Update
notes.notes:
Just in time for the Steam Spring Sale 🥳

[list]
[*] Smaller size-on-disk: 4.7 GB (used to be 11.6 GB) (now compressing some assets that are then decompressed on start)
[*] Using items on hotspots are now done through single-click to select the item rather than drag-n-dropping the item while holding down the mouse button
[*] Items that can't be used on hotspots (or combined with other hotspots) are now communicated to the player with a X-icon rather than the player saying something like "That doesn't seem to work"
[*] All translations now in place (German, Frensh, Spanish, Polish)
[/list]

Enjoy, and welcome to the Discord if you want to report anything or hang out 👍
https://www.warmkitten.com/discord
